crossRefs.note: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

translations.web: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
translations.bsb: In the case of a will, it is necessary to establish the death of the one who made it,
translations.kjv: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
translations.asv: For where a testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him that made it.
